source.evidence: The owner, 2026-11-11: 'Instance Battles need to last at least 2 minutes', then the decision: overworld-entered instance fights (field battles, battle starters) take 60-150 s solo at the recommended level with the real rotation, through more waves with gaps, an attacker cap and capped heal drops; dungeons keep their pace.

The client holds no combat power-up drop chances (ida.py: its one pickup chance table, PickupSpawnChanceLoad 01066cf0, belongs to the pirate ship battles' ShipZoneConfigLoad 010680f0); it draws the heart pickup (model 736 powerup_health_buff.adr) the server drops, so the hearts are power_ups.json's own health kinds, drawn from its standard table's health pool.
(R) Wave counts, gaps, attacker caps and heal chances, budgets and cooldowns are local balance, held by the simulator test; none was recovered.
